configuration.dimension_source: ../../feasibility/sources/Rules-2025.pdf, diagram on PDF page 5. Nominal dimensions, not a survey of this rink.
configuration.global_axes: Origin departure tee; +Y toward receiving tee; +X image-right in this source.
configuration.orientation_status: Source-specific orientation hypothesis from line layout and outgoing/incoming motion. Both panels treated as looking along +Y, with no broadcast mirroring. Not independently surveyed or solved from overlapping landmarks.
configuration.time_basis: Both panels are decoded from the same composite video frame. No additional production delay between panels measured.
configuration.height_model: Existing conditional cap-height correction, 0.136 m; each view has its own registered calibration.
configuration.association_rule: Unique new same-colour receiving track within 35 s, crossing receiving hog line inward; positive time and forward rink displacement from departure observations. No ranking to force a match.
configuration.development_status: Rule developed on this end, including inspection of ambiguous T08. No held-out association accuracy claimed.
configuration.t11_provisional_receiving_status: Unvalidated outside the original accepted bounds
